pairs: In finem,
Unto the end.
pro torcularibus.
For the wine and oil presses.
Psalmus ipsi Asaph.
A Psalm of Asaph himself.
Exsultate Deo adjutori nostro;
Exult before God our helper.
jubilate Deo Jacob.
Sing joyfully to the God of Jacob.
Sumite psalmum,
Take up a psalm,
et date tympanum;
and bring forth the timbrel:
psalterium jucundum cum cithara.
a pleasing Psalter with stringed instruments.
Buccinate in neomenia tuba,
Sound the trumpet at the new moon,
in insigni die solemnitatis vestræ:
on the noteworthy day of your solemnity,
quia præceptum in Israël est,
for it is a precept in Israel
et judicium Deo Jacob.
and a judgment for the God of Jacob.
Testimonium in Joseph posuit illud,
He set it as a testimony with Joseph,
cum exiret de terra Ægypti;
when he went out of the land of Egypt.
linguam quam non noverat, audivit.
He heard a tongue that he did not know.
Divertit ab oneribus dorsum ejus;
He turned the burdens away from his back.
manus ejus in cophino servierunt.
His hands had been a slave to baskets.
In tribulatione invocasti me,
You called upon me in tribulation,
et liberavi te.
and I freed you.
Exaudivi te in abscondito tempestatis;
I heard you within the hidden tempest.
probavi te apud aquam contradictionis.
I tested you with waters of contradiction.
Audi,
My people,
populus meus,
listen and I will call you to testify.
et contestabor te.
If,
Israël,
O Israel,
si audieris me,
you will pay heed to me,
non erit in te deus recens,
then there will be no new god among you,
neque adorabis deum alienum.
nor will you adore a foreign god.
Ego enim sum Dominus Deus tuus,
For I am the Lord your God,
qui eduxi te de terra Ægypti.
who led you out of the land of Egypt.
Dilata os tuum,
Widen your mouth,
et implebo illud.
and I will fill it.
Et non audivit populus meus vocem meam,
But my people did not hear my voice,
et Israël non intendit mihi.
and Israel was not attentive to me.
Et dimisi eos secundum desideria cordis eorum;
And so, I sent them away, according to the desires of their heart.
ibunt in adinventionibus suis.
They will go forth according to their own inventions.
Si populus meus audisset me,
If my people had heard me,
Israël si in viis meis ambulasset,
if Israel had walked in my ways,
pro nihilo forsitan inimicos eorum humiliassem,
I would have humbled their enemies, as if it were nothing,
et super tribulantes eos misissem manum meam.
and I would have sent my hand upon those who troubled them.
Inimici Domini mentiti sunt ei,
The enemies of the Lord have lied to him,
et erit tempus eorum in sæcula.
and their time will come, in every age.
Et cibavit eos ex adipe frumenti,
And he fed them from the fat of the grain,
et de petra melle saturavit eos.
and he saturated them with honey from the rock.
